COVID-19, also known as coronavirus disease 2019, is an illness caused by the virus SARS-CoV-2. It spreads primarily through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs, sneezes, talks, or breathes. The virus can also spread by touching surfaces contaminated with the virus and then touching the face. Symptoms can range from mild to severe and may include fever, cough, shortness of breath, fatigue, muscle aches, loss of taste or smell, and more. It is important to follow preventive measures such as wearing masks, practicing social distancing, and getting vaccinated to reduce the spread of the virus.
